name: Great Western Trail: El Paso

categories.label: Dollars owned
categories.hint: 1 VP for every 5 Dollars you own (enter total Dollars).

categories.label: Victory points on buildings
categories.hint: Total VP printed on the buildings you own.

categories.label: Trading post discs
categories.hint: VP for each disc on a highlighted trading post space.

categories.label: Worker card points
categories.hint: Total VP of your workers (sort all cards first).

categories.label: Cattle card points
categories.hint: Total VP of your cattle cards.

categories.label: Herder on Simmental space
categories.hint: +2 VP if your herder is on the Simmental space.

categories.label: Bonus tile points
categories.hint: VP depicted on bonus tiles you own.

categories.label: Completed objective tiles
categories.hint: Points of fully completed objectives only; each item counts for one objective.

tiebreakers.description: Most money left after converting Dollars to VP
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends when the Simmental pile is emptied and the next player reaches El Paso; each other player then gets one final turn. Solo variant (Sue automa) not modelled. Money tiebreaker wording is 'money left (after the conversion)': record leftover Dollars if tied.
